recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-18826 unless a future PA decision changes the Appointment start/end invariant semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-18826 was Published/Persuasive for the PA-owned Appointment resource after STU3. It reported that the app-2 human constraint, "Either start and end are specified, or neither", did not read clearly against `start.empty() xor end.exists()` and resolved to update the expression to `start.exists() = end.exists()`.
initial_application: No current-source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-18826 was found. The older STU3 history artifact still preserves the pre-resolution expression, but the active Appointment StructureDefinition introduced during the new build-core rework already contains `start.exists() = end.exists()`, and release4/release4b/release5 history artifacts also show the corrected expression.
additional_context: `source/fhir.ini` lists Appointment as an active resource, so `source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml` is current build input. Exact Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-18826 found no direct community records; broader Appointment start/end searches found later Appointment timing discussions but no evidence reversing or narrowing this app-2 correction.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active source already implements the Jira resolution: app-2 retains the same human description and uses `start.exists() = end.exists()`.
